community_pulse: The carnivore community is actively pushing back against sustainability criticism and embracing meat-eating without guilt. Simultaneously, there's strong interest in making carnivore accessible on tight budgets and exploring the science behind diet transformations.

topics.title: The Hypocrisy Trap: Why Processed Food Critics Have No Ground to Lecture Carnivores
topics.angle: Direct rebuttal using specific examples of ultra-processed ingredients vs. single-ingredient meat; frames the debate as nutritional honesty vs. performative morality
topics.why_now: The sustainability thread exploded this week with community frustration at being lectured — people want validation they're not crazy for this frustration
